name: JimWas Recorder
summary: Capture video, photos, and audio with hardware button triggers and Control Center controls.
description: JimWas Recorder supports background photo, video, and audio capture, configurable volume-button triggers, a companion app, and Control Center modules. Video can use the standard, Ultra Wide, or front camera where supported. Screen-off recording was tested on iOS 18.1.1 with Dopamine; iOS 16.3 was also tested. Other devices and firmware combinations have not been verified.
